{
  "blueprint_r01_sha256_if_visible": null,
  "candidate_docx_sha256": "0263017F16D81B1121BB97410DE9895B43B7A42F75632BF71A82B86426FBC2B0",
  "replacements": [
    {
      "search_exact": "- **官方來源**：行政院勞工署勞動力發展署 TTQS 查核佐證文件資料表－訓練機構版（共 9 頁），來源網址如側車所示。",
      "replace_with": "- **官方來源**：勞動部勞動力發展署 TTQS 查核佐證文件資料表－訓練機構版（共 9 頁），來源網址如側車所示。",
      "body_locator": "body §2.1 官方來源",
      "reason": "Body names the authority as 勞動部勞動力發展署; the Blueprint prefix 行政院勞工署 disagrees and is corrected to the official source (mapping preserved).",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **頁碼定位**：指標 13 位於證據表**第 4–5 頁**。",
      "replace_with": "- **頁碼定位**：指標 I13 位於證據表**第 4–5 頁**。",
      "body_locator": "body §2.1 頁碼定位",
      "reason": "Body uses indicator label I13; Blueprint 指標 13 drops the I.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **SAMPLE 內容**：有效問卷 15 份；機制有用性指數 4.2／5；遷移自評指數 3.8／5（詳第 6 節）。",
      "replace_with": "- **SAMPLE 內容**：有效問卷 15 份；機制有用性指數 4.1／5（209÷51）；遷移自評指數 3.8／5（詳第 6 節）。",
      "body_locator": "body §8.8 構面與合併指數",
      "reason": "Body computes Q1–Q4 combined mean as (63+48+60+38)/(15+12+15+9)=209÷51=4.098→4.1, not 4.2.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **觸發／時點**：結訓後第 6 週。",
      "replace_with": "- **觸發／時點**：113/12/01–113/12/08（所有機制完成後）。",
      "body_locator": "body §8.2 施測時點",
      "reason": "Body administers the questionnaire 113/12/01–12/08 after all mechanisms; the old draft's sixth-week timing is stale.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "**SAMPLE 統計（合成）**：有效問卷 15 份；機制有用性指數 4.2／5；遷移自評指數 3.8／5；可近性 4.0／5。",
      "replace_with": "**SAMPLE 統計（合成）**：有效問卷 15 份；機制有用性指數 4.1／5（209÷51）；遷移自評指數 3.8／5；可近性 4.0／5。",
      "body_locator": "body §8.8 構面與合併指數",
      "reason": "Second occurrence of the usefulness index; body value is 4.1 (209÷51), not 4.2.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "**對象**：結訓後 4–8 週內曾接觸任一本機制之學員",
      "replace_with": "**對象**：結訓後曾接觸任一本機制之學員",
      "body_locator": "body §8.2 對象",
      "reason": "Body's questionnaire object has no 4–8 週 window; the window is a stale-draft questionnaire timing claim that would wrongly exclude C/D participants (administered 12/01–12/08).",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "**施測時點**：結訓後第 6 週（113 年 8 月），或參與機制後 2 週內",
      "replace_with": "**施測時點**：113/12/01–113/12/08（所有機制完成後）",
      "body_locator": "body §8.2 施測時點",
      "reason": "Body fixes the questionnaire at 113/12/01–12/08 after all mechanisms; removes the sixth-week/August timing from the old draft.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **機制 C｜外部證照登記與查證（External-Certificate Registration & Verification）**：受理學員主動申報之外部證照，區分「學員自述」與「獨立查證完成」，留下發證單位、字號、查證日與查證來源。",
      "replace_with": "- **機制 C｜外部證照登記與查證（External-Certificate Registration & Verification）**：受理學員主動申報之外部證照，區分「學員自述」與「獨立查證完成」，正式運作時應留下經授權的發證單位來源、申報識別資料、查核日期與結果；本SAMPLE未提供任何真實外部來源，12 筆為情境內合成流程比對（12／18＝66.7%），非獨立外部查證。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.1 機制目的、§6.6 重要聲明",
      "reason": "Removes the claim that the mechanism already leaves issuer/字號/查證來源; matches body wording that this SAMPLE provides no real external source and C is an in-scenario synthetic comparison.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **目的**：建立證照申報與獨立查證機制，區分自述與查證。",
      "replace_with": "- **目的**：受理學員主動申報之外部證照，區分「學員自述」與「獨立查證完成」；本SAMPLE以情境內合成流程比對示範，不進行真實外部查證。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.1",
      "reason": "Old purpose implies completed independent verification; body limits the SAMPLE to in-scenario comparison with no real external check.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **必要欄位**：學員代碼、證照名稱、發證單位、字號、取得日、申報日、查證來源、查證日、查證結果、狀態。",
      "replace_with": "- **必要欄位**：學員代碼、示意類別、發證單位（REAL欄位待核）、申報內碼（非證書字號）、設定日期（非真實取得日）、申報日、情境步驟代碼、情境設定日（非查證日）、合成情境結果、狀態。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.4 證照查證登記表欄位",
      "reason": "Replaces external-verification field labels (查證來源/查證日/查證結果、字號、取得日) with the body's actual SAMPLE column labels; no certificate name or number is asserted.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **SAMPLE 內容**：113 年 10 月受理申報 18 件；完成獨立查證 12 件（查證來源為發證單位公開查詢或公文回覆），待補 6 件；未完成查證者僅得標記為「學員自述」。",
      "replace_with": "- **SAMPLE 內容**：113 年 10 月受理申報 18 件；完成情境內合成流程比對 12 件（非外部查證），待補 6 件；未完成查證者僅得標記為「學員自述」。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.4 情境流程比對紀錄、§6.5 數據計算",
      "reason": "Body shows 12/18 as in-scenario synthetic comparison, not independent issuer verification via public query or official reply.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **負責角色**：訓練承辦窗口（查證執行）；發證單位（查證回覆）。",
      "replace_with": "- **負責角色**：訓練承辦窗口（情境內合成流程比對執行）；本次未連線或查詢任何發證單位，發證單位回覆仍為 UNKNOWN。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.3 執行步驟（不連線、不查真實證照）",
      "reason": "Removes 發證單位（查證回覆） as a performed role; body states no connection/query of real certificates and issuer replies remain unavailable.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **證據來源**：證照影本、發證單位回覆（合成）。",
      "replace_with": "- **證據來源**：合成查證表；實際證照影本與發證單位回覆仍未取得（HOLD／UNKNOWN）。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.4 重要聲明、附錄 B E-C1",
      "reason": "Body uses 合成查證表 as the current form; real certificate copies and issuer replies are HOLD/UNKNOWN, not synthetic evidence.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **限制**：不得偽造發證單位、字號或查證結果；未完成查證不得列為已查證。",
      "replace_with": "- **限制**：不得偽造發證單位、字號或合成情境結果（非外部查證）；未完成查證不得列為已查證。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.6 例外／限制",
      "reason": "Body wording is 合成情境結果（非外部查證）; replaces the stale 查證結果 phrasing.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "| 證照 | 已申報／查證完成／查證待補／僅自述 | 未完成查證不得標為查證完成 |",
      "replace_with": "| 證照 | 已申報／SIM／REAL查核待補／僅自述 | SIM 僅代表合成演練內欄位比對步驟完成；不是獨立查證或外部來源證明 |",
      "body_locator": "body §6.7 狀態字典、附錄 A",
      "reason": "Body state values are 已申報／SIM／REAL查核待補／僅自述; 查證完成 would assert completed external verification.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **數據**：申報 18、完成查證 12、待補 6。",
      "replace_with": "- **數據**：申報 18、完成情境內合成流程比對 12、待補 6。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.5 數據計算",
      "reason": "Body counts 12 as completed in-scenario comparison, not completed verification.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **公式**：查證完成率 ＝ 12 ÷ 18 ＝ 66.7%。",
      "replace_with": "- **公式**：情境內流程比對完成率 ＝ 完成模擬比對 ÷ 申報 ＝ 12 ÷ 18 ＝ 66.7%。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.5 數據計算",
      "reason": "Body metric name and numerator definition are 情境內流程比對完成率 = 完成模擬比對 ÷ 申報.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **跟進**：10 月 31 日後繼續催補，補齊後更新查證結果。",
      "replace_with": "- **跟進**：10 月 31 日後繼續催補，補齊後更新合成情境結果（非外部查證）。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.6 跟進",
      "reason": "Body wording updates 合成情境結果（非外部查證）.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- **例外／限制**：不得偽造發證單位、字號或查證結果。",
      "replace_with": "- **例外／限制**：不得偽造發證單位、字號或合成情境結果（非外部查證）；未完成查證不得列為已查證。",
      "body_locator": "body §6.6 例外／限制",
      "reason": "Aligns with body wording; adds the body's 未完成查證不得列為已查證 limit.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "| 證照查證完成率 | 12 | 18 | 12÷18 | 66.7% |",
      "replace_with": "| 情境內流程比對完成率 | 12 | 18 | 12÷18 | 66.7% |",
      "body_locator": "body §10.4 跨機制指標彙整",
      "reason": "Body cross-mechanism table labels this row 情境內流程比對完成率.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "| IMP-03 | 提高證照查證完成率 | 訓練承辦窗口 | 114/06/30 | ≥90% | 證照查證登記表 | 受理截止後 | 未取得發證單位回覆前 HOLD | **NOT ADOPTED** |",
      "replace_with": "| IMP-03 | 提高有授權來源之REAL證照核驗完成率 | 訓練承辦窗口 | 114/06/30 | ≥90% | 證照查證登記表 | 受理截止後 | 未取得發證單位回覆前 HOLD | **NOT ADOPTED** |",
      "body_locator": "body §11.1 IMP-03",
      "reason": "Body IMP-03 content is 提高有授權來源之REAL證照核驗完成率; the old title implies already-completed independent verification.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- 證照查證完成率：12÷18＝66.7% ✔",
      "replace_with": "- 情境內流程比對完成率：12÷18＝66.7% ✔",
      "body_locator": "body §12.7 數學一致性預檢",
      "reason": "Body math-precheck label is 情境內流程比對完成率.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "；彙整截止 11 年 12 月 15 日。",
      "replace_with": "；彙整截止 113 年 12 月 15 日。",
      "body_locator": "body §10.1 彙整截止",
      "reason": "Typo treats the 113/12/15 consolidation cutoff as 11 years; body cutoff is 113 年 12 月 15 日.",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    },
    {
      "search_exact": "- 各機制分母：以該機制「可參與之結訓學員 18 人」為母數。",
      "replace_with": "- 各機制分母：回訓與心得以 18 名可參與結訓學員為分母；證照流程以 18 件合成申報為分母；模擬實作以 10 名實際參與者為首測分母。",
      "body_locator": "body §10.2 分子／分母與排除規則",
      "reason": "Body defines per-mechanism denominators; the Blueprint's blanket 18-person denominator conflicts with simulated practice (10) and certificate patents (18 synthetic filings).",
      "expected_occurrences": 1
    }
  ],
  "change_log": [
    "§1 官方來源: 行政院勞工署勞動力發展署 → 勞動部勞動力發展署 (align with body §2.1).",
    "§1 頁碼定位: 指標 13 → 指標 I13 (align with body §2.1).",
    "§4 第8節: usefulness index 4.2／5 → 4.1／5（209÷51）.",
    "§4 第8節: 觸發／時點 結訓後第 6 週 → 113/12/01–113/12/08（所有機制完成後）.",
    "§6 問卷: object 結訓後 4–8 週內曾接觸 → 結訓後曾接觸 (remove stale window).",
    "§6 問卷: 施測時點 結訓後第 6 週（113 年 8 月）… → 113/12/01–113/12/08（所有機制完成後）.",
    "§6 問卷: usefulness index 4.2／5 → 4.1／5（209÷51）.",
    "§3 + §4 第6節: mechanism C description, purpose, fields, SAMPLE result, roles, evidence source, limits recast from completed independent external verification to in-scenario synthetic comparison (12/18=66.7%); issuer replies/certificates remain UNKNOWN/HOLD.",
    "§5-3 狀態字典: 證照 states 查證完成／查證待補 → SIM／REAL查核待補 with body definition.",
    "§8.3: 數據/公式/跟進/例外 recast to 情境內流程比對完成率 and 合成情境結果（非外部查證）.",
    "§9: cross-mechanism row 證照查證完成率 → 情境內流程比對完成率.",
    "§9: denominator bullet expanded to body's per-mechanism denominators (18/18/10).",
    "§10: IMP-03 提高證照查證完成率 → 提高有授權來源之REAL證照核驗完成率.",
    "§13.2: 證照查證完成率 → 情境內流程比對完成率.",
    "§8 共通設定: 彙整截止 11 年 12 月 15 日 → 113 年 12 月 15 日."
  ],
  "unresolved": [
    "blueprint_r01_sha256_if_visible = null: the supplied Blueprint text contains no SHA-256 for itself; the only hash present (805386b77df045b396fabafed7a47d12491c25a0b5744edd9a04876caee34709) is the official source PDF, not the Blueprint.",
    "The body defines no 證照名稱 or 證書字號 field; §4 第6節 必要欄位 was remapped to the body's actual SAMPLE columns (示意類別／發證單位（REAL欄位待核）／申報內碼（非證書字號）) so no certificate name or number is invented.",
    "Body §6.1 also retains 區分「學員自述」與「獨立查證完成」 as a formal-operation distinction, not a completed SAMPLE result; the Blueprint keeps that phrase and it is not treated as a conflicting external-verification claim.",
    "§5-2 roster column header 證照查證 vs body §3.4 column C情境內流程比對: the body itself uses 證照查證 in the 名冊校驗 bullet, so the header was judged body-consistent and left unchanged.",
    "Body §4.6 records that S-16–S-18 補課 was not completed (HOLD) and body §4.7 adds 已補課; Blueprint §8.1 only says 補課選項 were provided. This is an omission, not a conflicting claim, so it was left unchanged.",
    "Blueprint-only planning statements with no body counterpart (e.g. §4 第1節 觸發／時點「機制彙整截止日後 5 個工作天」, §4 第4節 講師角色敘述, §13.5 版面要求) were left unchanged as they neither conflict with nor are corroborated by the body.",
    "Appendix 5-3 模擬實作 states omit body's HOLD value; left unchanged because it is an omission in a non-conflicting list."
  ]
}
